title: Finding accommodation in Bristol | Advice for international students
description:
We know that finding a place to live in Bristol is an important part of your travel preparations, but it can be difficult to know where to start and what to look for.

Along with our colleagues at UWE and Bristol City Council, we have recorded a short video with some helpful advice about finding private accommodation in Bristol.

0:00 Welcome
0:15 Who this video is for
0:33 What we'll cover
0:48 Introduction to the panel
1:14 Introduction to accommodation in Bristol
2:25 Accommodation costs
4:45 Private accommodation: questions to ask yourself
7:35 Where to look for accommodation
10:47 The rental contract / tenancy agreement
17:15 Legal rights when renting in the UK
24:34 Avoiding fraudulent advertisements
26:06 Further advice

Useful links:
University of Bristol advice for privately rented accommodation: https://www.bristol.ac.uk/accommodation/privately-rented 
Bristol SU Lettings: https://www.bristolsulettings.co.uk  
Bristol City Council private housing: email private.housing@bristol.gov.uk
Shelter Bristol: https://england.shelter.org.uk/get_help/local_services/bristol
